title: The Prophet Who Called Down Fire, Then Ran
notes: Distances are straight-line. Horeb shown dashed (traditional Jebel Musa is not certain). Broom tree not pinned: location unknown.

beats.text: He called down fire, then ran for his life.
On Mount Carmel, Elijah faces four hundred fifty prophets of Baal.
beats.say: On Mount CAR-mel, Elijah faces four hundred fifty prophets of BAY-al.

beats.text: Fire falls on the water-soaked altar and consumes offering, wood, stones.
beats.label: FIRE ON CARMEL

beats.text: Baal's prophets are then executed at the Kishon brook.
beats.say: BAY-al's prophets are then executed at the KY-shon brook.

beats.text: A small cloud rises from the sea, and the drought breaks.
Elijah outruns Ahab's chariot to Jezreel, about thirty kilometres.
beats.say: Elijah outruns AY-hab's chariot to JEZ-reel, about thirty kilometres.

beats.text: Queen Jezebel threatens him, so he runs for his life.
beats.say: Queen JEZ-eh-bel threatens him, so he runs for his life.

beats.text: He flees about one hundred fifty kilometres south, to Beersheba.
beats.say: He flees about one hundred fifty kilometres south, to Beer-SHEE-ba.

beats.text: A day beyond Beersheba, under a broom tree, he begs: it is enough.
beats.say: A day beyond Beer-SHEE-ba, under a broom tree, he begs: it is enough.
beats.display: It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life.

beats.text: An angel feeds him, and he walks forty days to Horeb.
beats.say: An angel feeds him, and he walks forty days to HOR-eb.
beats.label: DAYS

beats.text: Horeb, the mountain of God, is traditionally Jebel Musa. The site is uncertain.
beats.say: HOR-eb, the mountain of God, is traditionally JEB-el MOO-sa. The site is uncertain.

beats.text: Wind, earthquake, fire: the text says God was in none.
beats.label: NOT IN THE STORM

beats.text: God comes instead as a still small voice.
What's not proven: Horeb's location. Fire, flight or silence: which moment hits hardest?
beats.say: What's not proven: HOR-eb's location. Fire, flight or silence: which moment hits hardest?
